item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Cross-subscription backup for Azure Virtual Machines in Azure Backup
item.description:
Azure Backup now supports cross-subscription backup for Azure Virtual Machines. You can protect VMs with a Recovery Services vault in a different Azure subscription, as long as it is in the same tenant.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure Linux 4.0
item.description:
Azure Linux 4.0 is now generally available for Azure Virtual Machines and VM Scale Sets. Microsoft describes it as a first-party open-source Linux distribution purpose-built for Azure.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: SQL performance monitoring for SQL Server on Azure Virtual Machines
item.description:
Microsoft has released a public preview of Microsoft-managed performance monitoring for SQL Server on Azure Virtual Machines. It lets you monitor SQL Server on Azure VMs without creating custom collection scripts or manually correlating telemetry.

  • Source: Azure Updates
